parts.text: Born beside the Britain bank steps, where packs open and close all day.
Came down from the Minoc hills with dust on the boots.
Raised on the Vesper docks among ore crates and wet rope.
Grew up inside Trinsic's walls and still nods to the guards.
Out of Yew's woods, where the trees keep their own counsel.
From Skara Brae's island, used to a short ferry and long gossip.
Left Jhelom before the pits could make a name of me.
Came north from Serpent's Hold with a pack of tools.
Raised in Moonglow among reagent shops and late lamps.
From Magincia's streets, where pride was a warning and a boast.
Walked away from Buccaneer's Den looking for quieter coin.
Came through Papua's heat with a hatchet and a dry throat.
Out of Delucia, where the Lost Lands still feel half a rumour.
Raised west of Britain on farms that feed the city.
From Cove, where the water is close and the road is long.
Born near the Shame mountains, where travellers pass and do not linger.
Came from Nujel'm with a dislike of heat and a love of shade.
Raised in Ocllo, far from the old cities, still learning the roads.
Born in sight of Britain's moongate, which served as a clock.
Raised in Vesper's warehouses, counting crates before counting years.
Learned the Luna mall streets before learning the old towns.
Came out of Umbra, where night is a trade and a mood.
Learned to walk the Vesper bridges before I learned to count.
Raised by Britain's park, where the city pretends it is a village.
Slept to the Trinsic river and woke to the wall bells.
Grew up in the glow of Minoc forges and the cough of ore dust.
Born near the Yew shrine, where the woods keep older laws.
Raised among Skara rangers who named every bird on the wind.
Came off the Jhelom wharf with salt in the hair and little else.
Learned Moonglow's gate before I learned Moonglow's manners.
From Magincia after the pride broke, looking for a quieter boast.
Heard too many oaths in a Buccaneer's Den tavern and walked inland.
Worked Papua's docks until the jungle felt like a wall.
Left Delucia by the old gate with a pack of bread and a rumour.
Raised among Cove's boats, where every child can tie a line.
Stood watch at Serpent's Hold until the sea grew dull.
Learned Nujel'm's market prices before I learned its streets.
Took the Ocllo ferry north and did not take it back.
Sat the Luna steps and watched the mall eat whole days.
Came through Umbra's gate with night still on the cloak.
Learned Britain's bridges and the beggars who work them.
Raised in the Jhelom pits, cleaning blood off the sand between bouts.
Born to a Trinsic guard captain who taught sword drills before table manners.
Squired at Serpent's Hold for a knight who never lost a duel or a temper.
Grew up at the Lycaeum in Moonglow, burning holes in the practice dummies.
Came from Wind, where the mages teach fire before they teach kindness.
Orphaned by a pk raid on a Britain farm and raised by the town watch.
Learned archery in the Yew woods from rangers who never missed a deer.
Trained in the Skara Brae ranger lodge, shooting apples off fence posts.
Raised by a Jhelom duelist who kept a notch for every fair win.
Grew up in the Britain barracks, polishing helms for the royal guard.
Came of age hunting orcs near Cove with a borrowed spear.
Born in Minoc and sent to fight the mountain trolls at fifteen.
Learned the sword from a retired Order knight who lived above a Vesper tavern.
Grew up in Buccaneer's Den, fighting pirates' children for scraps.
Trained at the Britain Conservatory as a bard before choosing the blade.
Raised in Magincia by a fencing master who charged the rich and taught the poor.
Came from a Trinsic family that has sent a child to the guard every generation.
Born in Papua and hardened by jungle hunts for panther pelts.
Learned magery from a Moonglow hedge mage who blew up three kitchens.
Grew up near Destard, where the dragons made every child brave or gone.
Spent youth in the Cove militia, holding the fort gates against orcs.
Came to Jhelom to win a name in the pits and stayed for the fighting.
Raised by a Yew executioner who taught the weight of every blow.
Born to Serpent's Hold knights who trained with the sea at their backs.
Trained with a Vesper bounty hunter who collected heads for the guards.
Grew up in Delucia defending caravans from desert brigands.
Came of age at the Britain moongate, running off reds from the fields.
Learned the bow from an Ocllo fisher who shot gulls stealing the catch.
Raised in Nujel'm, trained as a palace guard before walking away.
Born to a Minoc mining family and took up the mace to fight cave beasts.
Grew up watching duels in the Jhelom arena and copying every move.
Came from Skara Brae, where rangers teach the young to track before they read.
Learned to fight from a Britain street brawler who never started a fight.
Trained under a Trinsic weapons master who made students swing until dawn.
Raised in Wind by mages who sent the child out to test spells on mongbats.
Born in Vesper to a guardsman killed defending the ore docks.
Spent youth in a Yew hunting lodge, skinning deer and sharpening arrows.
Came of age in Magincia fending off pirate raids with a family sword.
Grew up in Cove, learning that orcs flee from anyone who stands firm.
Learned war magic from a Moonglow battle mage with scorched sleeves.
Raised in Serpent's Hold, carrying water to knights at the practice yard.
Born to a Jhelom sword smith who tested every blade on the pit fighters.
Trained with a Minoc militia that guarded the mines from ettins.
Grew up near the Britain graveyard, fighting skeletons for coin.
Came from Papua, where every hunter learns to kill a snake before breakfast.
Spent youth in the Trinsic arena, sparring with the sons of nobles.
Raised by a Delucia desert ranger who could shoot a scorpion at fifty paces.
Born in Ocllo, drilled with a spear by a mother who hated pirates.
Learned to cast from a Nujel'm court mage who valued power over poetry.
Grew up in Vesper, guarding ore carts from bandits on the river road.
Came to Britain as a squire and left as a knight of nothing in particular.
Trained at Jhelom under a famed duelist who fought only for honor.
Raised in Yew by a ranger who taught the silence before the shot.
Born in Minoc and blooded against the troll packs of the northern hills.
Grew up in Skara Brae, where young rangers race each other to the river.
Came of age defending a Magincia estate from treasure hunters.
Learned the halberd from a Serpent's Hold veteran with one ear.
Spent youth in the Moonglow mage tower, scrubbing floors for spell lessons.
Raised by Trinsic guards who swore a fair fight is the only fight.
Born near Wrong, where the lizardmen taught fear and then taught courage.
Trained in the Cove fort by an old sergeant who hated orcs more than rain.
Grew up in a Britain tavern where the patrons settled debts with fists.
Came from Delucia with a spear, a waterskin and a hunger for battle.
Learned fencing from a Nujel'm dancer who fought the way she danced.
Raised in Papua, hunting the jungle beasts that preyed on the villages.
Born to Vesper fishers who fought off pirates as often as they fished.
Spent youth in the Jhelom pits, fighting until the crowd forgot the name.
Grew up in Minoc guarding the smiths from ore thieves.
Came of age as a Yew bowman in a company that hunted brigands.
Learned to fight in the Trinsic sewers, chasing ratmen for a bounty.
Raised in Serpent's Hold by knights who valued courage over coin.
Born in Magincia and trained in the sword to guard a merchant's fleet.
Trained with the Britain watch, walking the bank steps at night.
Grew up in Skara Brae learning to shoot from the ferry deck.
Came from Wind with fire in the hands and little patience for fools.
Learned the mace from a Minoc priest who believed in firm answers.
Raised by a Jhelom widow who kept her husband's sword sharp for the child.
Born to Cove hunters who shot deer by moonlight.
Spent youth guarding the Moonglow reagent shops from thieves.
Grew up in Ocllo, where the few guards trained every able child.
Came of age on the road between Britain and Trinsic, hunting bandits.
Learned war from a Delucia captain who fought the ophidians.
Raised in Nujel'm, trained in the palace yard with blunted steel.
Born in Yew and raised on stories of rangers who stood against dragons.
Trained at Serpent's Hold for a knighthood that never came.
Grew up near Covetous, fighting harpies that raided the farms.
Came from Vesper with a longsword and a grudge against brigands.
Learned magery at the Lycaeum and left when the books ran out of fire.
Raised in Trinsic by a family of archers who guarded the walls.
Born near the Hythloth mountains, where the daemons were bedtime stories.
Spent youth in Papua defending the docks from sea raiders.
Grew up in the Britain fields, chasing wolves from the sheep.
Came of age in Jhelom, learning to take a hit as well as give one.
Learned to fight from a Skara Brae ranger who lost an eye to a bear.
Raised in Minoc, where the militia drills in the snow.
Born to Magincia sailors who defended their ship with cutlasses.
Trained by a Cove hermit who had once been a famous swordsman.
Grew up in Moonglow, casting sparks at the telescope just to annoy the astronomer.
Came from Wind, sent out to learn the world with a spellbook and a knife.
Learned the bow from Yew rangers who hunted without a sound.
Raised in Serpent's Hold, where even the cooks carry swords.
Born in Delucia to a family of caravan guards.
Spent youth in Trinsic training with wooden swords in the city square.
Grew up in Vesper, fighting river pirates with a boat hook.
Came of age at the Jhelom pits, earning scars and small purses.
Learned to cast fire from a Nujel'm alchemist who loved explosions.
Raised in Britain by an old anti-pk who swore to guard the moongate.
Born in Ocllo and trained in the spear by island guards.
Trained in Minoc by stocky miners who fought with their picks.
Grew up in Skara Brae learning archery from a ranger's daughter.
Came from Cove, where the orc raids make every child a soldier.
Learned the axe from a Yew woodsman who fought brigands with it too.
Raised in Papua by hunters who tracked panthers through the jungle.
Born to a Jhelom fighter who lost a leg and gained a teacher's patience.
Spent youth in Magincia as a duelist for hire, settling rich men's quarrels.
Grew up guarding the Britain bank, watching for thieves and reds.
Came of age in Trinsic, where honor is taught in every school.
Learned war magic in Moonglow and practised it on the Moonglow gate campers.
Raised in Serpent's Hold by a knight who taught the value of a steady shield.
Born near Deceit and raised on the dare of entering it.
Trained with a Vesper mercenary band that guarded caravans to Minoc.
Grew up in Delucia, fighting in the desert with a curved blade.
Came from Yew, where the courthouse needed guards and paid in bread.
Learned the sword in Jhelom from a pit victor who never boasted.
Raised in Nujel'm, trained as a bodyguard for traveling merchants.
Born in Britain to a pk hunter who never came home one night.
Spent youth in Cove learning to fight orcs with a pitchfork.
Grew up in Minoc, hunting the ettins that stole miners' ore.
Came of age in Skara Brae, winning archery contests at the harvest fair.
Learned to fight from a Trinsic gladiator who retired to teach.
Raised in Ocllo by a fisherman who fought off sea serpents with a harpoon.
Born in Papua and trained with the blowgun before the bow.
Trained with a Magincia merchant guard that protected the silk caravans.
Grew up near Shame, where elementals made the roads a proving ground.
Came from Wind, trained in combat spells by a stern old mage.
Learned the spear from a Serpent's Hold knight who fought from horseback.
Raised in Vesper, where every child learns to fight on narrow bridges.
Born to Yew rangers who taught archery as a form of prayer.
Spent youth in Jhelom sparring with anyone who would stand still.
Grew up in Britain dreaming of the Lord's guard and settling for adventure.
Came of age in Delucia, where the desert tests every fighter.
Learned magery from a Moonglow mage who valued precision over power.
Raised in Trinsic among smiths who made the guards' swords.
Born in Cove to a militia captain who kept the orcs at bay.
Trained in Nujel'm under a sword master who fought blindfolded.
Grew up in Skara Brae, shooting at targets painted on barn doors.
Came from Minoc with a hammer and a knack for smashing skeletons.
Learned archery in Papua from hunters who shot birds from the canopy.
Raised by a Magincia fencing instructor who valued grace in the kill.
Born in Ocllo, trained by the island watch to fight off raiders.
Spent youth in Serpent's Hold scrubbing armor for the knights.
Grew up in Jhelom, where every child can name the best pit fighters.
Came of age in Vesper, fighting the undead that crawl out of the graveyard.
Learned war from a Britain veteran who fought in the old orc wars.
Raised in Yew, where the rangers still guard the ancient trees.
Born in Delucia to a sword dancer who fought in the market square.
Trained in Wind among mages who fought each other for practice.
Grew up in Trinsic hearing tales of heroes who guarded the gates.
Came from Nujel'm with a scimitar and a quick tongue.
Learned to fight in Cove, where the forest hides more orcs than trees.
Raised in Minoc by a guard who protected the mines at night.
Born near Despise, where the orcs were neighbours and enemies.
Spent youth in Moonglow as a mage's bodyguard.
Grew up in Skara Brae, where the rangers are the only law.
Came of age in Papua, fighting the ophidians at the jungle edge.
Learned the sword in Magincia from a disgraced noble who needed pupils.
Raised in Britain, watching the anti-pk guilds ride out at dusk.
Born to Serpent's Hold archers who watched the sea for pirate sails.
Trained in Jhelom by a pit master who paid in bread and bruises.
Grew up in Ocllo, fighting pirates who raided the harbour.
Came from Vesper with a war axe and a family debt to settle.
Learned magic in Wind and combat in the wild beyond it.
Raised in Delucia, where the guards fight terathans on the desert edge.
Born in Yew and trained as an archer for the forest patrol.
Spent youth in Trinsic, sparring in the shadow of the city walls.
Grew up in Cove, where the orc fort taught every child to fight.
Came of age in Nujel'm, guarding the palace treasury.
Learned the mace in Minoc from a smith who fought trolls on weekends.
Raised by a Skara Brae ranger who taught the bow before the spoon.
Born to Moonglow mages who wanted a scholar and raised a battle mage.
Trained in Magincia's guard, protecting the merchant streets.
Took up the sword after a red killed a brother on the Minoc road.
Swore an oath at the Shrine of Valor and has not broken it yet.
Left a quiet Yew farm the day the brigands burned the barn.
Picked up a dead guard's halberd during an orc raid on Cove and kept it.
Won a first duel in the Jhelom pits at fourteen and never stopped fighting.
Walked out of the Lycaeum with a half-finished spellbook and a burning itch.
Survived a Destard trip as a porter and came back wanting a sword.
Carried arrows for Yew rangers until one handed over a bow.
Spent a summer hunting mongbats outside Britain for pocket money.
Lost the family home to a Despise orc raid and joined the hunt that followed.
Joined a Trinsic guild of anti-pks after a bank-step murder.
Once got knocked flat by a Jhelom pit master and asked for lessons on the spot.
Signed on as a caravan guard in Delucia at fifteen, lying about the age.
Fought off a ghoul at the Britain graveyard with a shovel and found a calling.
Left Magincia after challenging a noble to a duel and winning too well.
Ran messages between Serpent's Hold and Trinsic during the orc troubles.
Was a Moonglow bookbinder until a stray fireball changed everything.
Took an old sword off a skeleton in Deceit and kept swinging it.
Grew up poor in Vesper and learned that fists open more doors than begging.
After the Covetous harpies took a flock, went back with a bow.
Saved a merchant on the Britain road and got a sword as payment.
Was taught magery by a Wind mage who wanted an apprentice with a strong back.
Watched a pk loot a friend at the Yew gate and swore never to be helpless.
Spent years as a Jhelom pit sweeper before stepping onto the sand.
Left Papua after killing a panther that had terrorised the village.
Found an old Order shield in a Trinsic attic and took it as a sign.
Fought in the Cove militia at twelve, too young and too stubborn to stay home.
Survived a shipwreck off Serpent's Hold by clinging to a knight's shield.
Joined a Vesper watch patrol after the river pirates raided the docks.
Once carried a wounded ranger out of Wrong and never forgot the weight.
Took up archery after missing a wolf that killed the family dog.
Earned a first sword clearing ratmen from the Britain sewers.
Was chosen by a Serpent's Hold knight to squire after winning a footrace.
Walked from Ocllo to Jhelom to learn the pits and never went back.
Joined a mage guild in Moonglow after setting a barn on fire by accident.
Fought in a Minoc tunnel collapse rescue and came out wanting harder work.
Was a Nujel'm palace servant who learned the sword by watching the guards.
Spent a winter in the Ice dungeon as a guide and came out tougher.
Beat the best archer in Skara Brae at sixteen and took up the bow for good.
After an ettin crushed the family mine cart, took up the mace.
Left Delucia to hunt the terathans that raided the southern roads.
Chased a thief across Britain once and liked the feeling.
Picked up magery to heal a sick parent and learned to burn along the way.
Rode with a Chaos guild for a season and learned what war really costs.
Was born on a battlefield near Trinsic, or so the family tells it.
Drilled with wooden swords behind a Vesper tavern every night.
Joined the Britain watch after the guards failed to save a neighbour.
Fought a lizardman at the Wrong entrance with a cooking knife and won.
Took the Jhelom pit oath young and learned it binds for life.
Walked into Hythloth on a dare and walked out with a daemon's horn.
Joined an Order guild after the Chaos riders burned a village near Yew.
Was a Magincia fishmonger until a pirate raid showed a knack for the blade.
Shot a hawk out of the sky at ten and the Yew rangers came calling.
Survived three pk ambushes on the Minoc road and learned from each one.
Left Nujel'm with a scimitar and a vow to see every dungeon.
Found courage in the Cove fort when the orcs broke through the gate.
Once cleared a Britain farm of wolves and never went back to farming.
Joined the Trinsic guard at sixteen and quit at twenty to hunt dragons.
Got a first spellbook from a Moonglow mage who died owing a favour.
Took up the spear after watching Serpent's Hold knights joust.
Lost a sister to a Shame elemental and trained until it felt safe.
Spent a year hunting trolls near Vesper for the bounty board.
Was a bard in Britain until a crowd turned ugly and the lute became a club.
Earned a name in the Jhelom pits by never taking a cheap shot.
Ran from a red once and spent every year since learning to stand.
Fought off brigands at the Yew crossroads with a woodcutting axe.
Took up magery at the Lycaeum after reading a book on Flamestrike.
Joined a Skara Brae hunting party at twelve and outshot the grown ones.
Was a Papua dockhand until an ophidian raid put a spear in the hands.
Swore to the Valor shrine after a friend died fighting a drake.
Survived a gate trap near the Britain moongate and came back with friends.
Left Ocllo after winning a spear-throwing contest against a pirate.
Grew tired of Minoc mining and traded the pick for a war hammer.
Earned a first bounty by bringing a murderer's head to the Trinsic guards.
Joined an anti-pk guild in Vesper that hunted reds by the moongates.
Was a Delucia stable hand who learned to fight defending the horses.
After losing a bet in Jhelom, stepped into the pits to pay the debt.
Carried a knight's banner in a Serpent's Hold parade and wanted more.
Found a magic wand in a Covetous chest and learned to use it.
Walked from Magincia to Britain to join a famous warrior guild.
Took up fencing after a Nujel'm duelist mocked a borrowed sword.
Spent youth hunting deer near Yew and later hunted brigands instead.
Joined a mage circle in Wind after passing its test of fire.
Fought a bear with a stick in the Britain woods and lived.

Became a fighter after the Trinsic guards turned away a plea for help.

Took up the halberd to guard a Vesper bridge for a merchant guild.
Was a Minoc tavern bouncer who decided to get paid for fighting monsters.
Joined a Jhelom warband after winning ten fights in a single season.
Found a rusty broadsword in the Britain river and cleaned it for years.
Spent a harsh season in Papua clearing the jungle of giant snakes.
Learned to fight after a thief robbed the family shop in Magincia.
Walked the Britain to Trinsic road alone at fourteen to prove a point.
Was a Yew monk who left the abbey to protect travellers instead.
Took up archery after watching Skara Brae rangers defend the ferry.
Joined the Serpent's Hold garrison to escape a boring life in Ocllo.
Fought in the great Cove siege and came out a veteran at sixteen.
Earned a spellbook by clearing a Moonglow cellar of giant rats.
Left Delucia to find a teacher worthy of a desert sword.
Once duelled a Chaos knight in Trinsic and lost, then trained for a year.
Joined a Britain militia to fight the orc bands camping near the farms.
Was a Vesper ferry guard who fought river pirates for a living.
Survived a Destard dragon attack by hiding behind a rock and learning patience.
Took up magery after a Wind mage saved a life with a single spell.
Became a fighter after the Minoc guards were too slow to stop a raid.
Walked into the Jhelom pits as a joke and walked out with a purse.
Joined a ranger band in Yew that hunted the wolves of the northern woods.
Was a Nujel'm guard who left to hunt the monsters of the mainland.
Fought off a ratman gang in the Britain sewers and found a calling.
Earned a first coin fighting mongbats for a Cove farmer.
Took up the mace after a skeleton shrugged off a sword in Deceit.
Joined an Order guild in Britain to fight the Chaos raiders.

Survived a harpy swarm near Covetous and came back with a bow.

Fought in the Jhelom pits to pay for a sister's healing.
